description: The line plot illustrates the performance of CodeRAG-Bench across different chunking sizes, measured by the number of tokens on the x-axis, which ranges from 200 to 900 in increments of 200, and the y-axis, which represents performance values ranging from 10 to 40. Four distinct data series are plotted: "Tutorials" (blue circles connected by a solid line), "Library Documentation" (red circles connected by a solid line), "StackOverflow posts" (yellow circles connected by a solid line), and "Github files" (green circles connected by a solid line). The "Tutorials" line starts at approximately 23, rises to a peak of about 29 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 28. The "Library Documentation" line begins at roughly 26, increases to a peak of approximately 32 at 800 tokens, and then decreases to about 27. The "StackOverflow posts" line starts at around 33, decreases steadily to about 12 at 900 tokens. The "Github files" line begins at approximately 28, rises to a peak of about 33 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to around 30. All lines show a general trend of increasing performance up to 800 tokens, followed by a decline or stabilization.
